ques: How do I get started with Smart Saathi?
ans: Create an account, add the people you want to support, and choose the reminders and alerts that matter most. The app guides you through each step in a clear, simple way.

ques: What happens if a reminder is missed?
ans: Smart Saathi sends a notification so someone can follow up, helping everyone stay on track and reducing the chance of missed medications or appointments.

ques: Can I see recent activity and alerts in one place?
ans: Yes. The app brings reminders, recent activity, and important notifications together in a single overview so it is easier to stay informed.

ques: Is the app easy for older adults to use?
ans: Yes. Smart Saathi is designed with large buttons, clear voice prompts, and a simple experience so it is comfortable for older adults to navigate.

ques: Can I set reminders for both medication and appointments?
ans: Yes. Smart Saathi lets you schedule reminders for medication, doctor visits, and other important daily activities so nothing is missed.

ques: Can I adjust the alerts I receive?
